description: Live-built NWS snapshot for a SkiReady family resort (Breckenridge, Keystone, Steamboat, Park City, Palisades Tahoe, Stowe): official base/summit elevation, current temperature and wind, the lowest NWS wind chill in the next 48 hours with the matching kids' cold band (AAP/CPS), active NWS alerts, forecast periods and the nearest hospital. If a resort isn't covered it says so; never guess.
